consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of electrical energy at ML-3202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on ML-3202 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. ML-3202 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during shift handover while the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 3 December 2017 a potential incident was recorded on ML-3202 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
